items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And John Vardar. I like his tenor and his bass sax, too, Alasdor.

ctx.x: He played the rhythm of the clarinet, man.
And John Vardar. I like his tenor and his bass sax, too, Alasdor.

You would? Yeah. Very fun. I really love his tenor playing. Fine, boy. Who started that style of tenor? I'm always curious about that, you know? There's so many guys that play that way. The style? Yeah, that many plays. So that style of saxophone doesn't have to be tenor.
